profile.name: Saransh Singh
profile.tagline: security research, offensive tooling, and the bits that break
profile.shortBio: I find vulnerabilities, build red-team tooling, and write about exploitation tradecraft. My work spans binary exploitation, web security, adversary emulation, and detection engineering.

about.fullBio:
I work at the sharp end of offensive security. On the red side: binary exploitation, web application penetration testing, C2 framework development, and full-scope adversary emulation. On the blue side: SIEM detection engineering, log analysis, and understanding attacker TTPs to build better defenses.

What connects both is the constraint problem. Finding a WAF bypass in three characters, weaponizing a race condition into a full compromise, or engineering a C2 channel that blends into legitimate HTTP traffic — the interesting work is always about doing more with the constraints you're given.

My interests land in vulnerability research, malware analysis, cloud security, and anything that requires understanding both the attacker's creativity and the defender's rigor. I don't draw a hard line between red and blue; the best security operators understand both sides of the kill chain.

experience.title: Cyber Security Intern
description: Completed a structured Cybersecurity Internship Programme (16 May – 28 June 2026) delivered by SafeSkillz Ltd., London, through instructor-led sessions, weekly assessments, and practical lab assignments.
Gained hands-on exposure across cybersecurity fundamentals, network & cloud security, threat intelligence, web application security, and digital forensics & incident response.
Conducted Android mobile application penetration testing and system exploitation using the Metasploit Framework, covering Linux and Windows privilege escalation techniques.
Completed a Capstone Project — Vulnerable Machine Assessment — producing a technical report documenting methodology, findings, and recommended remediation measures.
Applied knowledge of UK GDPR compliance and data privacy standards through practical exercises aligned to UK regulatory requirements.

experience.title: Security Researcher
